messages:
Ava (People Ops): quick q — Sam's team has a promo that landed in Midcycle, but comp change submitted after payroll cutoff. manager asked about backpay and how to show evidence. any quick rules?
Sam (Eng Manager): ugh, yep. promoted on 2026-02-10, comp change entered 2026-03-01. payroll already closed for feb. is retro to promo date expected?
Rohan (Manager): from my last cycle, finance did retro to promo effective date if evidence + manager approval before X days. not 100% tho.
Priya (People Ops): short answer: we can do retro pay (backpay) to the effective date if promo was approved before payroll processed, or if we have an approved exception. need: manager approval, promo evidence, and payroll ticket.
Miguel (Finance): adding detail — payroll cutoff rules: monthly payroll closes on last day of month at 18:00 UTC. anything entered after requires manual off-cycle adjustment. Off-cycle has extra lead time and may hit next pay run.
Lina (Payroll): off-cycle steps: 1) confirm effective date 2) confirm total gross diff 3) attach approval docs 4) submit to payroll queue. off-cycle fee may apply for urgent same-month adjustments.
Sam (Eng Manager): OK — manager approved on 2026-02-12 via email, I have the thread. I didn't realize system entry was late. will that be enough? :eyes:
Priya (People Ops): yes that'll usually be fine. we need the manager approval in Slack/email and the promo evidence pack (role profile + updated level rubric notes). also include the signed comp change form if your org uses it.
Ava (People Ops): paste a minimal template below for the payroll ticket so you don't miss fields:
```nEmployee: Jane Doe (jane@redwood.com)
Employee ID: 45123
Effective date: 2026-02-10
Old base: $140,000
New base: $160,000
Gross backpay amount: $1,538.46
Manager approval: Sam (link to email)
Supporting docs: promo evidence pack (link)
Requested action: Off-cycle retro to effective date
```
Rohan (Manager): perfect — does comp band change require any approvals beyond manager/people ops?
Priya (People Ops): if the new base is within band, only manager + people ops. if outside band (>= 10% over band median or outside payband), we need Finance + People Ops leadership signoff. Miguel, confirm?
Miguel (Finance): correct. if outside band, route to comp committee (weekly cadence) or get exec signoff for urgent. expect 2–5 business days.
Sam (Eng Manager): the bump is 14% and moves them to next band. so we'll need comp committee. timeline impact?
Miguel (Finance): comp committee backlog is typically 3 business days, add payroll processing time. anticipate off-cycle completing in 7–10 business days if approved.
Ava (People Ops): if you want to speed up, include all docs and a short justification memo in the first ticket to reduce back-and-forth. a one-paragraph rationale helps reviewers.
Sam (Eng Manager): thanks. i'll open the payroll ticket with the template and attach manager approval + role doc. any subject line prefs?
Priya (People Ops): use: "Off-cycle retro: Jane Doe — promo effective 2026-02-10 — comp committee attached"
Lina (Payroll): once ticket is in, I'll ack and flag for priority if comp committee approves quickly.
hr-bot: Reminder — please ensure you cc people-ops@redwood.com on payroll tickets for all promo-related off-cycle requests.
Sam (Eng Manager): added. will update here once submitted. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Ava (People Ops): appreciate it — loop back if comp committee asks for more evidence. we'll keep an eye on the ticket.
